label: Fixed possible facts versus fixed constituent bearers and actual realization
term: fixed possible facts versus fixed constituent bearers and actual realization
resolution: §3 fixed possible-fact domain/Barcan laws do not alone assert a fixed ordinary-being constituent set. §7Cor1 separately presumes being/property involvement and assumes actual involvement implies existence; the same-bearer all-world reading needed by Hence remains an interpretation/application obligation. Existing account K nonemptiness/all-world realization is an analyst interface, not a source alias or theorem from domain fixedness. Ordinary existence transfers only with real membership/realization for the same fact and candidate. Necessary fact, being-or-system and ordinary cause/God signatures remain distinct.
